help.hi: Khaali chhodo to project ka sample text use hoga.
help.en: Leave empty to use the project's sample text.

help.hi: Translator agent is language mein output dega.
help.en: The translator agent writes in this language.

summary.hi: Do in-process agents (Summarizer aur Translator) typed Envelope messages se baat karte hain: ek request bhejta hai, dusra reply karta hai, aur AuditLog har message dekhta hai.
summary.en: Two in-process agents (Summarizer and Translator) talk through typed Envelope messages: one sends a request, the other replies, and an AuditLog sees every message.

hi: Har Envelope mein sender, recipient, type aur correlation_id dekho.
Request/response (sync) aur event (fire-and-forget) ka fark dekho.
Audit log mein poori baatcheet ka record.
en: Look at sender, recipient, type and correlation_id on each Envelope.
Notice request/response (sync) versus event (fire-and-forget).
The audit log keeps a record of the whole conversation.

hi.title: MessageBus ne do agents ko joda
lines: dm_bus.py ka MessageBus har Envelope ko sahi recipient tak pahunchata hai.
SummarizerAgent ne request bheji, TranslatorAgent ne correlation_id ke saath reply kiya (dm_agents.py).
AuditLogAgent ko events milte rahe bina kisi ko rokke: yahi fire-and-forget hai.

en.title: The MessageBus connected two agents
lines: The MessageBus in dm_bus.py routes every Envelope to the right recipient.
SummarizerAgent sent a request and TranslatorAgent replied with the same correlation_id (dm_agents.py).
AuditLogAgent received events without blocking anyone: that is fire-and-forget.

inputs.name: task
inputs.default: Our sales went from 950 to 1200 units. What's the growth %? Then write a short launch post about it.

help.hi: Manager isse specialist agents (tools) mein baantega.
help.en: The manager splits this across specialist agents (tools).

summary.hi: Manager agent specialist agents ko normal tools ki tarah call karta hai: har specialist sirf apna chhota task dekhta hai aur JSON result lautaata hai.
summary.en: A manager agent calls specialist agents like ordinary tools: each specialist sees only its small task and returns a JSON result.

hi: Manager ke tool calls: analyst aur writer jaise specialists.
Har specialist ka alag context (manager ki poori history nahi).
Result JSON: ok, output, steps, tokens.
en: The manager's tool calls to specialists such as analyst and writer.
Each specialist has its own context (not the manager's full history).
Result JSON: ok, output, steps, tokens.

hi.title: Agent ek tool ban gaya
lines: agent_as_tool.py ne ek poore Agent ko @tool jaisa bana diya.
Manager (agent_as_tool_team.py build_team) ne unhe function ki tarah call kiya.
Specialist fail ho to bhi manager crash nahi hota: error result mein aata hai.

en.title: An agent became a tool
lines: agent_as_tool.py wrapped a whole Agent so it looks like a @tool.
The manager (build_team in agent_as_tool_team.py) called specialists like functions.
If a specialist fails the manager does not crash: the error comes back in the result.

05-agent-communication/03-handoffs.default_stdin:
I was charged twice this month!
Also I can't log in, it says account locked.

stdin.hi: Customer ke messages (har line ek turn). Offline mode apne scripted turns chalata hai.
stdin.en: Customer messages (one turn per line). Offline mode plays its own scripted turns.

summary.hi: Support desk: triage agent billing ya tech agent ko transfer_to_x tool se control de deta hai; baatcheet ki history saath jaati hai.
summary.en: Support desk: the triage agent hands control to the billing or tech agent with a transfer_to_x tool; the conversation history goes along.

hi: path: triage -> billing jaisi handoff chain.
Dusre message pe wahi active agent continue karta hai.
customer_id server side se inject hota hai, LLM ko nahi dikhta.
en: The handoff chain in path, such as triage -> billing.
On the second message the same active agent continues.
customer_id is injected server side and never shown to the LLM.

hi.title: Control ek agent se dusre ko gaya
lines: handoff_swarm.py ka Swarm har agent ko transfer_to_x tools deta hai.
Triage ne sahi specialist chuna; specialist ne list_invoices / refund_invoice jaise tools chalaye (handoff_support.py).
Transfers ki limit hai, taaki agents aapas mein ping-pong na karein.

en.title: Control moved from one agent to another
lines: The Swarm in handoff_swarm.py gives each agent transfer_to_x tools.
Triage picked the right specialist, which then ran tools such as list_invoices and refund_invoice (handoff_support.py).
Transfers are capped so the agents cannot ping-pong forever.

inputs.name: query
inputs.default: 4 nights in Goa from Delhi, budget 25000 rupees

help.hi: Agents isi ko board pe todkar plan banayenge.
help.en: Agents break this down on the board and build a plan.

summary.hi: Blackboard architecture: flight, hotel, budget aur itinerary agents ek shared board padhte-likhte hain; controller board dekh ke agla agent chunta hai.
summary.en: Blackboard architecture: flight, hotel, budget and itinerary agents read and write one shared board; a controller looks at the board and picks the next agent.

hi: Controller har round kaunsa agent chalata hai.
Budget toota to BudgetAgent hotel hata ke 'cheaper' hint chhodta hai.
Agents aapas mein seedha baat nahi karte, sirf board se.
en: Which agent the controller runs each round.
When the budget breaks, BudgetAgent removes the hotel and leaves a 'cheaper' hint.
Agents never talk directly, only through the board.

hi.title: Shared board se team ne plan banaya
lines: blackboard_store.py ka InMemoryBlackboard sabka shared state hai.
blackboard_trip.py ka Controller board ki halat dekh ke agla KnowledgeSource chunta hai.
Isse agents loosely coupled rehte hain: naya agent jodna = board pe naya key.

en.title: The team planned through a shared board
lines: InMemoryBlackboard in blackboard_store.py is everyone's shared state.
The Controller in blackboard_trip.py looks at the board and picks the next KnowledgeSource.
Agents stay loosely coupled: adding an agent means adding a key on the board.

summary.hi: Asyncio event bus pe order pipeline: fraud-check, notification aur analytics agents topics subscribe karte hain; retry, dead-letter aur idempotency ke saath.
summary.en: An order pipeline on an asyncio event bus: fraud-check, notification and analytics agents subscribe to topics, with retries, a dead-letter queue and idempotency.

hi: order.created -> fraud check -> order.approved / order.flagged jaise events.
Fail hua SMS retry hota hai, phir bhi fail to dead-letter mein.
Duplicate event dobara process nahi hota (idempotent).
en: Events like order.created -> fraud check -> order.approved / order.flagged.
A failed SMS is retried and ends up in the dead-letter queue if it keeps failing.
A duplicate event is not processed twice (idempotent).

hi.title: Events se agents jude, bina ek dusre ko jaane
lines: pubsub_bus.py ka EventBus har subscriber ki apni queue rakhta hai (at-least-once delivery).
pubsub_orders.py ke FraudCheckAgent, NotificationAgent, AnalyticsAgent sirf topics jaante hain.
Browser mein asyncio ek chhote sync loop pe chala, isliye kaam parallel ki jagah baari baari hua.

en.title: Agents connected through events without knowing each other
lines: The EventBus in pubsub_bus.py keeps one queue per subscriber (at-least-once delivery).
FraudCheckAgent, NotificationAgent and AnalyticsAgent in pubsub_orders.py only know topics.
In the browser asyncio ran on a small sync loop, so work ran in turns instead of in parallel.

summary.hi: Har agent ek alag FastAPI service hai; registry se discovery, bearer auth, timeouts/retries, aur async job (POST job -> poll ya webhook).
summary.en: Each agent is its own FastAPI service with registry discovery, bearer auth, timeouts/retries, and async jobs (POST job -> poll or webhook).

hi: Services registry mein register hoti hain aur orchestrator unhe dhundhta hai.
Sync /invoke aur async job ka fark.
Bina token ke request 401 pe rukti hai.
en: Services register with the registry and the orchestrator discovers them.
The difference between sync /invoke and an async job.
A request without a token stops at 401.

hi.title: Recorded run: agents HTTP pe baat kar rahe the
lines: httpsvc_registry.py registry hai, httpsvc_service.py har agent ko FastAPI app banata hai.
httpsvc_client.py ka AgentClient timeouts aur retries (sirf 5xx pe) sambhalta hai.
Browser mein servers nahi chal sakte, isliye yeh asli local run ki recording hai.

en.title: Recorded run: agents talking over HTTP
lines: httpsvc_registry.py is the registry; httpsvc_service.py turns each agent into a FastAPI app.
AgentClient in httpsvc_client.py handles timeouts and retries (only on 5xx).
Servers cannot run in a browser, so this is a recording of a real local run.

summary.hi: SQLite notes ka MCP server (tools, resources, resource template, prompts) stdio pe; client JSON-RPC se usse baat karta hai.
summary.en: An MCP server for SQLite notes (tools, resources, a resource template, prompts) over stdio; a client talks to it with JSON-RPC.

hi: initialize -> capabilities handshake.
tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list.
tools/call ka request aur result JSON.
en: initialize -> the capabilities handshake.
tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list.
The tools/call request and result JSON.

hi.title: Recorded run: MCP ka JSON-RPC lifecycle
lines: mcp_notes_server.py ka build_server() tools, resources aur prompts declare karta hai (mcp 2.2 MCPServer).
Client ne pehle initialize kiya, phir list kiya, phir tool call kiya.
stdio ke liye subprocess chahiye jo browser mein nahi hota, isliye yeh recording hai.

en.title: Recorded run: the MCP JSON-RPC lifecycle
lines: build_server() in mcp_notes_server.py declares tools, resources and prompts (mcp 2.2 MCPServer).
The client initialized first, then listed, then called a tool.
stdio needs a subprocess, which a browser does not have, so this is a recording.

summary.hi: LLM-agnostic agent jo MCP servers se judta hai, unke tools ko agentkit Tools mein badalta hai (bridge) aur agent loop se chalata hai.
summary.en: An LLM-agnostic agent that connects to MCP servers, converts their tools into agentkit Tools (a bridge) and runs them through the agent loop.

hi: Kaunse servers connect hue aur kitne tools mile.
Agent ka tool call MCP ke through server tak jaata hai.
Destructive tool se pehle approval.
en: Which servers connected and how many tools were found.
The agent's tool call travels through MCP to the server.
Approval before a destructive tool.

hi.title: Recorded run: agent ne MCP tools use kiye
lines: mcp_bridge.py ka MCPBridge MCP tool schemas ko agentkit Tool banata hai.
mcp_client_agent.py ka build_agent kai servers jod sakta hai; confirm_destructive risky tools rokta hai.
Server subprocess mein chalta hai, isliye website pe recording hai.

en.title: Recorded run: the agent used MCP tools
lines: MCPBridge in mcp_bridge.py turns MCP tool schemas into agentkit Tools.
build_agent in mcp_client_agent.py can connect several servers; confirm_destructive guards risky tools.
The server runs in a subprocess, so the website shows a recording.

summary.hi: Wahi MCP server Streamable HTTP pe (remote server), bearer auth ke saath; security guards jaise tool pinning aur untrusted output wrapping.
summary.en: The same MCP server over Streamable HTTP (a remote server) with bearer auth, plus security guards such as tool pinning and wrapping untrusted output.

hi: --self-host se server aur client ek hi process mein.
HTTP pe wahi JSON-RPC messages.
Agent note add karke search karta hai.
en: --self-host runs server and client in one process.
The same JSON-RPC messages, over HTTP.
The agent adds a note and then searches for it.

hi.title: Recorded run: MCP over HTTP
lines: mcp_http_server.py ka build_http_app server ko HTTP endpoint banata hai (BearerAuthMiddleware ke saath).
mcp_http_client.py ka http_transport client ko us URL se jodta hai.
mcp_security.py tool poisoning aur prompt injection se bachav dikhata hai.

en.title: Recorded run: MCP over HTTP
lines: build_http_app in mcp_http_server.py exposes the server as an HTTP endpoint (with BearerAuthMiddleware).
http_transport in mcp_http_client.py connects the client to that URL.
mcp_security.py shows defenses against tool poisoning and prompt injection.

summary.hi: Currency/travel expert agent A2A server ke roop mein: Agent Card, JSON-RPC message/send, task lifecycle aur artifacts.
summary.en: A currency/travel expert agent served over A2A: an Agent Card, JSON-RPC message/send, the task lifecycle and artifacts.

hi: GET /.well-known/agent.json: naam aur skills.
message/send ka task aur uska state (completed).
Server logs mein agent ke andar ke tool calls.
en: GET /.well-known/agent.json: the name and skills.
The task returned by message/send and its state (completed).
The agent's internal tool calls in the server logs.

hi.title: Recorded run: ek A2A server se baat
lines: a2a_travel_agent.py ka create_app agentkit Agent ko A2A app banata hai; make_card skills batata hai.
a2a_protocol.py mein Message, Part, TaskState jaise types hain.
Server (uvicorn) browser mein nahi chal sakta, isliye Terminal 1 + Terminal 2 ka asli run record kiya.

en.title: Recorded run: talking to an A2A server
lines: create_app in a2a_travel_agent.py serves an agentkit Agent as an A2A app; make_card lists its skills.
a2a_protocol.py holds the Message, Part and TaskState types.
The server (uvicorn) cannot run in a browser, so a real Terminal 1 + Terminal 2 run was recorded.

summary.hi: Orchestrator agents ko unke card se dhundhta hai, skill se chunta hai, task delegate karta hai, aur input-required pe dobara jawab bhejta hai.
summary.en: An orchestrator discovers agents from their cards, picks one by skill, delegates a task, and answers again when the task is input-required.

hi: Card fetch aur skill ke hisaab se agent choice.
input-required state: agent ne currency poochi.
Usi taskId pe follow-up se completed.
en: Card fetch and choosing an agent by skill.
The input-required state: the agent asked which currency.
A follow-up on the same taskId leads to completed.

hi.title: Recorded run: orchestrator ne kaam delegate kiya
lines: a2a_orchestrator.py ka AgentRegistry cards padhta hai; SkillRouter sahi agent chunta hai.
delegate() message/send bhejta hai aur input-required pe user se jawab leke wahi task continue karta hai.
Remote agent server chahiye, isliye website pe recording hai.

en.title: Recorded run: the orchestrator delegated work
lines: AgentRegistry in a2a_orchestrator.py reads the cards; SkillRouter picks the right agent.
delegate() sends message/send and, on input-required, continues the same task with the user's answer.
The remote agent needs a server, so the website shows a recording.

summary.hi: Do alag tarah se bane A2A agents (agentkit agent aur bina LLM ka hand-written agent) ek trip planner orchestrator ke through saath kaam karte hain.
summary.en: Two A2A agents built in different ways (an agentkit agent and a hand-written agent with no LLM) work together through a trip planner orchestrator.

hi: Dono agents ke cards alag hain, protocol same.
Packing agent bina LLM ke jawab deta hai.
Trip plan mein dono ke results jude hue.
en: The two agents have different cards but speak the same protocol.
The packing agent answers without any LLM.
The trip plan combines both results.

hi.title: Recorded run: alag vendors, ek protocol
lines: a2a_packing_agent_raw.py bina SDK aur bina LLM ke A2A bolta hai.
a2a_trip_planner.py ka plan_trip dono ko call karke TripPlan banata hai.
Yahi A2A ka fayda hai: andar kuch bhi ho, bahar protocol ek.

en.title: Recorded run: different vendors, one protocol
lines: a2a_packing_agent_raw.py speaks A2A with no SDK and no LLM.
plan_trip in a2a_trip_planner.py calls both and builds a TripPlan.
That is the point of A2A: whatever is inside, the protocol outside is the same.

help.hi: Writer draft likhega, Editor review karega.
help.en: The writer drafts, the editor reviews.

help.hi: Role (persona, goal, rules) se bane prompts print honge.
help.en: Prints the prompts generated from each role (persona, goal, rules).

summary.hi: Role kya hota hai: persona, goal, tools, output contract. Writer aur Editor do roles milke draft ko revise karte hain.
summary.en: What a role is: persona, goal, tools and an output contract. A Writer and an Editor revise a draft together.

hi: Role se bane system prompts.
Editor ka verdict (approve ya changes).
Revise loop kab rukta hai.
en: The system prompts generated from each role.
The editor's verdict (approve or changes).
When the revise loop stops.

hi.title: Do roles ne milke likha
lines: role_design.py ka Role dataclass persona, goal aur rules se system prompt banata hai.
write_with_editor() Writer aur Editor ko baari baari chalata hai jab tak Editor approve na kare.
Achha role = saaf output contract; BAD_ROLE jaisa vague role drift karta hai.

en.title: Two roles wrote together
lines: The Role dataclass in role_design.py builds a system prompt from persona, goal and rules.
write_with_editor() alternates Writer and Editor until the Editor approves.
A good role has a clear output contract; a vague one like BAD_ROLE drifts.

inputs.name: idea
inputs.default: a tiny calculator library with an add function

help.hi: PM -> Architect -> Developer -> QA isse banayenge.
help.en: PM -> Architect -> Developer -> QA will build this.

summary.hi: Software team pipeline: Product Manager, Architect, Developer aur QA ek ke baad ek, har task ka output agle ka context.
summary.en: A software team pipeline: Product Manager, Architect, Developer and QA in sequence, each task's output becoming the next one's context.

hi: Har role ka task aur expected output.
Developer ka save_file tool.
QA developer ko wapas bhej sakta hai (limited baar).
en: Each role's task and expected output.
The developer's save_file tool.
QA can send work back to the developer a limited number of times.

hi.title: Crew ne line mein kaam kiya
lines: sequential_crew.py ka SoftwareCrew tasks ko order mein chalata hai; sirf declared context aage jaata hai.
Developer ne save_file se Workspace mein files likhin.
QAVerdict fail ho to Developer ko feedback ke saath dobara mauka.

en.title: The crew worked in a line
lines: SoftwareCrew in sequential_crew.py runs tasks in order; only the declared context is passed on.
The developer wrote files into the Workspace with save_file.
If the QAVerdict fails, the developer gets another try with the feedback.

inputs.name: question
inputs.default: Should I install solar panels at home?

help.hi: Supervisor researcher, writer aur critic ko kaam baantega.
help.en: The supervisor routes work to the researcher, writer and critic.

help.hi: Itne rounds ke baad supervisor ruk jayega.
help.en: The supervisor stops after this many rounds.

summary.hi: Supervisor (router LLM) har round decide karta hai kaunsa worker agla chalega: researcher (tools ke saath), writer ya critic, jab tak FINISH na ho.
summary.en: A supervisor (router LLM) decides each round which worker goes next: the researcher (with tools), the writer or the critic, until FINISH.

hi: Route JSON: next aur reason.
Workers sirf apna hissa dekhte hain, supervisor poora board.
Rukne ki wajah: FINISH, max_rounds ya repeat guard.
en: The Route JSON: next and reason.
Workers see only their slice; the supervisor sees the whole board.
Why it stopped: FINISH, max_rounds or the repeat guard.

hi.title: Supervisor ne team chalayi
lines: supervisor_team.py ka SupervisorTeam llm_json se Route (next, reason) leta hai.
Har worker ka output BoardEntry banke shared board pe jaata hai.
max_rounds aur same worker baar baar na chune jaane ka guard infinite loop rokte hain.

en.title: The supervisor ran the team
lines: SupervisorTeam in supervisor_team.py gets a Route (next, reason) through llm_json.
Each worker's output goes on the shared board as a BoardEntry.
max_rounds and a guard against picking the same worker repeatedly prevent infinite loops.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.default: Launch a habit-tracker mobile app next month

help.hi: Manager isse team leads mein, leads workers mein baantenge.
help.en: The manager splits this across team leads, and leads across workers.

summary.hi: Manager -> team leads (marketing, engineering) -> workers. Har level plan todta hai, results upar summary banke aate hain.
summary.en: Manager -> team leads (marketing, engineering) -> workers. Each level breaks the plan down and results roll up as summaries.

hi: LaunchManager ka plan: kaunsi team kya karegi.
TeamLead workers ko tasks deta hai.
Report upar summary ki tarah aati hai.
en: The LaunchManager's plan: which team does what.
Each TeamLead hands tasks to workers.
Reports roll up as summaries.

hi.title: Teen level ki team
lines: hierarchical_teams.py ka LaunchManager goal ko Assignments mein todta hai.
TeamLead (lead_prompt) apne workers ko WorkerTask deta hai aur TeamReport banata hai.
Galat team/worker naam skip hote hain aur record hote hain.

en.title: A three-level team
lines: LaunchManager in hierarchical_teams.py splits the goal into Assignments.
Each TeamLead (lead_prompt) gives its workers WorkerTasks and writes a TeamReport.
Invented team or worker names are skipped and recorded.

inputs.name: task
inputs.default: Plan a 3-day Goa trip for 2 people under INR 30,000

help.hi: Saare roles ek hi chat mein isse plan karenge.
help.en: All roles plan this in one shared chat.

help.hi: llm = manager LLM, rules = keywords/@mention, round_robin = baari baari.
help.en: llm = a manager LLM, rules = keywords/@mention, round_robin = in turns.

help.hi: Itne turns ke baad chat ruk jayegi.
help.en: The chat stops after this many turns.

summary.hi: AutoGen jaisa group chat: saare roles ek transcript share karte hain; selector agla speaker chunta hai; TERMINATE ya consensus pe khatam.
summary.en: An AutoGen-style group chat: all roles share one transcript, a selector picks the next speaker, and it ends on TERMINATE or consensus.

hi: Speakers ka order selector ke hisaab se.
Rukne ki wajah aur kitne turns.
Alag selector chuno aur fark dekho.
en: The speaker order chosen by the selector.
Why it stopped and after how many turns.
Pick a different selector and compare.

hi.title: Ek chat, kai roles
lines: group_chat.py ka GroupChat sab messages ek shared transcript mein rakhta hai.
RoundRobinSelector, RuleBasedSelector ya LLMSelector agla speaker chunte hain (LLM galat naam de to fallback).
TERMINATE keyword, consensus ya max_turns pe chat rukti hai.

en.title: One chat, many roles
lines: GroupChat in group_chat.py keeps every message in one shared transcript.
RoundRobinSelector, RuleBasedSelector or LLMSelector picks the next speaker (with a fallback if the LLM names someone invalid).
The chat stops on the TERMINATE keyword, consensus or max_turns.

help.hi: debate = pro/con + judge, consistency = kai samples ka majority, moa = mixture of agents.
help.en: debate = pro/con + judge, consistency = majority of several samples, moa = mixture of agents.

inputs.name: text
inputs.default: Should a startup use microservices from day one?

help.hi: Debate ka motion ya consistency/moa ka sawaal.
help.en: The debate motion, or the question for consistency/moa.

summary.hi: Agents ek dusre se behas karte hain aur judge rubric se score deta hai; saath mein self-consistency (majority vote) aur mixture-of-agents.
summary.en: Agents argue against each other and a judge scores them with a rubric; also self-consistency (majority vote) and mixture-of-agents.

hi: PRO aur CON ke arguments har round.
Judge ke scores aur winner.
judges > 1 pe jury votes.
en: PRO and CON arguments each round.
The judge's scores and the winner.
Jury votes when judges > 1.

hi.title: Behas se faisla
lines: debate_judge.py ka debate() rounds chalata hai; debater_prompt har side ko apna stance deta hai.
Judge Verdict mein SideScore (rubric) deta hai; jury ho to majority.
self_consistency() aur mixture_of_agents() kai jawabon ko milakar behtar answer banate hain.

en.title: A decision through debate
lines: debate() in debate_judge.py runs the rounds; debater_prompt gives each side its stance.
The judge returns a Verdict with SideScores (rubric); a jury takes the majority.
self_consistency() and mixture_of_agents() combine several answers into a better one.

inputs.name: once
inputs.default: My order A100 never arrived, I want a refund

help.hi: Browser mein interactive chat nahi hota, isliye ek message bhejo. Try: 'where is my order A200?' ya 'my wifi router is not working'.
help.en: The browser cannot run an interactive chat, so send one message. Try: 'where is my order A200?' or 'my wifi router is not working'.

summary.hi: Bina central controller ke peers (triage, orders, refunds, tech) ek dusre ko handoff karte hain; shared context variables saath chalte hain.
summary.en: Peers (triage, orders, refunds, tech) hand off to each other with no central controller; shared context variables travel along.

hi: path: triage -> refunds jaisi chain.
context mein customer_id aur order details.
Sirf allowed handoff edges; max_handoffs ping-pong rokta hai.
en: The path chain, such as triage -> refunds.
customer_id and order details in the context.
Only allowed handoff edges; max_handoffs stops ping-pong.

hi.title: Swarm: control khud aage badha
lines: swarm_handoffs.py ka Swarm har handoff ko auto-generated transfer_to_* tool banata hai.
lookup_order, issue_refund, troubleshoot jaise tools shared context use karte hain.
Supervisor wale lab se fark: yahan koi boss nahi, agents khud control dete hain.

en.title: Swarm: control moved on by itself
lines: The Swarm in swarm_handoffs.py turns each handoff into an auto-generated transfer_to_* tool.
Tools such as lookup_order, issue_refund and troubleshoot use the shared context.
Unlike the supervisor lab there is no boss: agents pass control themselves.
